dialogue:
Speaker1: That country’s still got a royal family in the 21st century? Let’s bring on the guillotine.
Speaker2: They've got nobles too, so it’d be super unfair if they just got rid of the king lol.
Speaker1: Just send in the army, wipe 'em out, and take their stuff, right? lol
Speaker2: Even without a royal family, if there's a state, someone will end up ruling over others anyway.

Speaker1: What kind of mom gives up custody and divorces over a cat?
Speaker2: So the husband knew she was like that and still went for it? Lol, sounds like he’s just as bad.
Speaker1: Things are wild, like back in medieval Europe. Maybe we should just hunt down these cat moms and burn 'em at the stake.
Speaker2: For real, there are tons of cat moms but not a single cat dad in sight—guess that’s just a thing with them.
Speaker1: Still, to give up custody and get divorced? The guy should be holding on tight to that lifeline.

Speaker1: It's hilarious how they're trashing it, saying it's boring and that the writer's gonna flop.
Speaker2: No idea where that came from lol. You’re not saying it got scratched 'cause of some harassment talk, right?
Speaker1: Ugh, guess they got triggered by their usual comments.
Speaker2: It's hilarious that the yellow monkeys are saying they hate PC. If anyone's benefiting from it, it's you guys...

Speaker1: You know what's really sad? Even if someone approaches me first, I can't make it happen 'cause I'm just a hopeless loner.
Speaker2: For real, even if looks aren't great, you still feel inferior to guys who are confident, funny, and can talk well.
Speaker1: For real, unless you're like a total heartthrob, girls don't really find you attractive if you don't have a good sense of humor.
Speaker2: Even if a guy's kinda quiet, if he’s good at something, that’s attractive too, but most Korean girls really care too much about humor.

Speaker1: This airline's got a ton of issues, for real.
Speaker2: Seriously, have you even been on a plane? You sit there with the emergency exit seat agreement; it's way roomier and more comfortable than other seats.
Speaker1: Sounds like you're just mad about the exit row? Maybe check your own level first... lol.
Speaker2: First, take a good look at your own character. I’m just saying, chill at home.

Speaker1: Isn't this a total win after grinding since my early 20s?
Speaker2: It's impressive you saved that much, but you gotta find other ways to leverage it.
Speaker1: What are you talking about? You salarymen won't save a dime no matter how hard you try.
Speaker2: You don’t know about stocks and crypto? With that, even your life could do a total 180.

Speaker1: A college girl jumped out of a taxi and died because the driver took a weird route.
Speaker2: Heard that taxi driver got acquitted? The passenger asked for the destination twice, but he didn’t answer.
Speaker1: They say he has hearing issues. He couldn’t drive for years, so his life’s a mess now.
Speaker2: There's a life lost, and the messed-up livelihood is the issue? How scared must she have been to jump?
Speaker1: It's all that excessive anxiety, not the driver's fault. This society that breeds fear is what killed her!

Speaker1: Wow, how much work did you do to wear down your fingerprints?
Speaker2: Forty years of wrecking copyright.
Speaker1: What a dumb way to make someone a criminal, seriously.
Speaker2: You really think I just did that for 40 years? This is some next-level dumbassery, lmao.

Speaker1: What? So those app nerds are still carrying around separate transit cards?
Speaker2: Wait, seriously, what? And those app fanboys were out here praising Apple like crazy?
Speaker1: Why the heck are they even using that dumb phone?
Speaker2: They're still saying it's 'in progress' in 2025, lol. What a joke, those app worshippers, haha.

Speaker1: Gonna be late coming home 'cause of dinner with the team. You guys eat without me.
Speaker2: What’s with all these dinners? Everyone’s just eating and not working, huh?
Speaker1: What kind of talk is that? Can’t you say anything better to your husband?
Speaker2: Got it, just eat and come home early.
Speaker1: There's an old saying that even the finest feast tastes like dirt. I'm not going because I want to. Just trying to get you to understand.

Speaker1: You’re still living like that, getting free meals as you get older?
Speaker1: For real, still living that bottom-of-the-barrel life, huh?
Speaker1: Whatever, go throw some bricks or something.
Speaker2: Guess carrying bricks my whole life gives my words some weight.

Speaker1: Why are all these sketchy guys popping up on my Insta feed lately?
Speaker2: Their legs are super short, lol.
Speaker1: For real, those pants are ugly as hell. The confidence to walk around in those is legendary.
Speaker2: If you go to Hongdae, there are tons of those guys. Zero appeal.

Speaker1: Korean kids have an average IQ of 105, ranking first, while Southeast Asia's is like 80, lmao.
Speaker2: Ain't some of your ancestors mixed in with them? Ask your mom.

Speaker1: No need to go far, remember that leaked wiretap from last time?
Speaker1: Can’t even say a word of protest about this.
Speaker2: What’s the problem when those jerks are spying on their own people?
Speaker1: That's a problem, and that's a problem too, right?
Speaker2: The Chinese do it all the time, though.

Speaker1: Why lie about buying it from abroad? That person’s really messed up.
Speaker2: That girl character in the drama is actually messed up.
Speaker1: What’s up with her getting a job somewhere else when no one even cares?
Speaker2: It's just the setup, acting like they know lol.

Speaker1: I saw the agency of that actor who recently committed suicide is suing the haters.
Speaker2: It's crazy how some people don't get that words can actually drive someone to take their life.
Speaker1: Anyone can file a lawsuit. Whether it actually leads to punishment is a whole different story.
Speaker2: Watching fights online or offline is always a blast lol.

Speaker1: Why hiking, though?
Speaker2: When you're pushed to your limits hiking, that's when a person's true nature shows.
Speaker1: Man, my ex was a total mess the first time we went hiking—complaining about everything, like how hard it was and her legs hurt. Just all kinds of annoying.
Speaker2: It's a way to see if she's the type to bail as soon as a guy hits a rough patch financially or otherwise.

Speaker1: No appeal for the weebs, for real.
Speaker2: No wonder Yankees love Vinland Saga.
Speaker1: Just remember, the opinions of weebs don’t mean anything.
Speaker2: They'll probably go rate-bomb it just 'cause their fave's low on the list, lol.

Speaker1: Having a narcissist friend is just exhausting and uncomfortable, I swear.
Speaker2: For real. If they don't even know they're a narcissist, it's a whole mess.
Speaker1: Ignoring them is the way to go, but I keep forgetting that.
Speaker2: Gotta hit those cowards with the truth when they can't handle facts.
Speaker1: Yeah, either hit 'em with the truth or just shut up.

Speaker1: I'm so excited I can't sleep.
Speaker2: Haha, just chill and make some fun plans.
Speaker1: I won't be able to have as much fun since we'll be video chatting every night, but just having some freedom is exciting.
Speaker2: Don’t let them see you smile till the end. The moment you do, everything falls apart. Just be careful.
Speaker1: For sure. If I'm not careful, I could get dragged into a mess. You know that better than anyone.
Speaker2: For sure. You're a real boss lady. You must've totally taken out Admiral Yi Sun-sin in a past life.

Speaker1: I totally get why a girl would cheat if the guy's that pathetic.
Speaker2: Wait, so it’s the guy’s fault? The one cheating’s the problem, not him.
Speaker1: Look at that guy's face, he totally looks like a one-minute man lmao.
Speaker2: Talking to you feels like it’s messing with my vibe, so I think I’ll just avoid you.

Speaker1: The airport's packed 'cause all the foreign workers are heading home for the long holiday.
Speaker2: For real, the number of pure Korean tourists keeps going up every year.
Speaker1: Are all the Chinese folks bailing out?
Speaker2: Didn’t you know Korean tourists are gonna be number one visiting Japan in 2024? lol

Speaker1: Please, reduce the patient-to-nurse ratio to 5. I can totally prevent bedsores.
Speaker2: Sounds like it won't be easy with those clueless docs making ridiculous claims.
Speaker1: Improving conditions is a priority, and we need legal protection for the various medical tasks we’ve been doing instead.
Speaker2: They’ve been getting a free ride, dumping all the annoying stuff on nurses, but once the nursing law gets changed, that’ll stop... so they’re all freaking out about losing their cash flow.

Speaker1: Heard there's a theory you can live healthy just breathing, no food or water, and it's trending in the U.S.
Speaker2: What are you talking about in a pig society like America? They don’t fast anyway, lol.
Speaker1: Heard some people have actually died trying that, yikes.
Speaker2: It's wild how strong human will is, seeing people actually believe that nonsense and end up dying from it...

Speaker1: Man, the older I get, the more I’m shelling out for these events. My salary isn’t budging, but the expenses just keep piling up.
Speaker2: Yikes, seems like a lot of people are passing away in winter. It's tough.

Speaker1: Just because you’re older doesn’t mean you act like an adult.
Speaker2: Look who's talking, Mr. Know-It-All.
Speaker1: Just 'cause you're older doesn't mean you're a decent adult; you get called out for your messed-up actions.
Speaker2: I gotta make sure I don’t age like that.

Speaker1: Did you see that dog's face today? They caked on the makeup.
Speaker2: She's known for her heavy makeup, though.
Speaker1: Fixing that kind of look ain't easy.
Speaker2: It's kinda sad at this point.

Speaker1: Here are the drawings I did this year, what do you think? Can't show more 'cause of the size limit.
Speaker2: You should thank AI, or else you'd just be a struggling artist, but now you can blame AI for that, lol.
Speaker1: That's harsh, but it's people like you that hold others back from growing.
Speaker2: You can't even get perspective right, can't do human figures, and your composition's just flat shapes. Just give it up.

Speaker1: My wife's style is on point, right? lol Even in sweats and slippers, she looks good.
Speaker2: Just a plain old aunt, lol.
Speaker1: With your taste, it's no wonder you're still single.

Speaker1: Thinking that living like that looks messy is normal, but saying it out loud and putting someone down is just messed up.
Speaker2: Thinking that way isn’t normal either; treating everyone with low wages and education like total losers is just lame.
Speaker1: Still, people don’t say it out loud. Thinking it’s okay to just blurt out whatever’s on your mind shows a total lack of basic education, no matter who you are.
Speaker2: Just seeing someone minding their own business and thinking bad thoughts about them is messed up.

Speaker1: Yikes, only one person applied for 188 spots in the OB-GYN residency. That's a big deal.
Speaker2: Yikes, with a birth rate of 0.7%, I get it.
Speaker1: I heard some places in Gangwon do big cash bonuses for having kids?
Speaker2: What’s the point of having kids if there are no jobs? Just makes it tough to get by.
Speaker1: Isn't it kinda serious that there are more women going to plastic surgery than to OB-GYNs these days?
Speaker2: Is that really the women's fault? It's a problem with society as a whole.

Speaker1: It's that the mental age is pretty low working at a factory anyone can get into.
Speaker2: Think age is a big deal or something?
Speaker1: They've got swagger and attitude for days.
Speaker2: Now that I got my certification, it’s like they can’t handle it.

Speaker1: What kind of baby-hating nonsense is going on? Took my kid to a restaurant and saw all sorts of crazy stuff.
Speaker2: Kids are so precious these days!
Speaker1: For real, kids can run around and be loud sometimes, but people just gotta complain.
Speaker2: Your kid is kinda wild, though. That energy's no joke lol.

Speaker1: Looks like alcoholism is a disease that only ends in death. They brought my dad home from the police station yesterday.
Speaker2: Ugh, not again? You’re really going through it.
Speaker1: Every time he drinks, he’s out there beating people up. I even had to go apologize to the victim yesterday.
Speaker2: Aren't you gonna cut him off? How long are you gonna deal with this? Your dad's hopeless.
Speaker1: I kinda wish he'd just go away quietly.
Speaker2: Yikes, you must be really feeling it to say that. Hang in there.

Speaker1: Kids these days don’t even know how to look people in the eye, just glued to their phones.
Speaker2: Guess that's why they just text or use their phones even when they meet up.
Speaker1: They’re always glued to their phones, so they’ve got no patience and don’t know how to do anything.
Speaker2: It's a big problem that they want everything done fast.

Speaker1: Haha, it’s not “try the pork” but more like “you’re gonna eat this pork, it’s awesome,” so funny lol.
Speaker2: That way, we cut down the wait time and can eat fast, then chill after.
Speaker1: So the restaurant owner really likes guys.
Speaker2: Back in my 20s, I struggled with pork belly, and now in my 30s, here I am all about that pork belly…

Speaker1: Just don’t drink or smoke, use sunscreen, eat well, and get good sleep. It’s that simple.
Speaker2: I drink all the time at 50 and still get told I look young everywhere I go.
Speaker1: Y'all think you're young, but to us 20-somethings, you're all just old dudes.
Speaker2: Better slather on that sunscreen before you get any older. But if you're too broke to buy it, might as well not even have kids, right?

Speaker1: No matter how pretty a woman is, she ages and gets less attractive over time—it's just nature, gotta accept it.
Speaker2: I get it in my head... I say I accept and love it, but what do I do when it doesn't feel that way? Ugh.
Speaker1: So you can't even keep it together and ended up cheating with a college girl? Ugh...
Speaker2: You'd be the same if you were in that situation; would you feel like it if you saw those wrinkles?

Speaker1: Stop wasting food at home and get a job or something.
Speaker2: Hope you get hit by a drunk driver while walking and take a trip to the moon, lol.
Speaker1: Your belly's way saltier, just saying lol.
Speaker2: At first, you acted all logical, but now you’re just salty.

Speaker1: But can that person even handle social life?
Speaker2: Kids like that need some financial therapy.
Speaker1: That kid's so far gone into the far-right, can't even tell what's what.
Speaker2: For real, they really wanna go to the bakery.

Speaker1: I get that people hate it, but I don’t get the whole boycott and trashing the company thing.
Speaker2: Whoa, your mindset is way more gross. You should just eat more.
Speaker1: How long do you think Koreans will stick to their guns? If interest rates were lower, I would've jumped in at the bottom. What a waste.
Speaker2: This person is seriously disgusting. They say 758 people got caught in the dough mixer and got hurt or died over the last 5 years...

Speaker1: I mean, there’s no right answer, but I feel like one day something bad’s gonna happen to them.
Speaker2: People like that are definitely dealing with some kind of deficiency or family issues.
Speaker1: It's already so common to see that kind of nonsense, but they still wanna take the lead and fight.
Speaker2: Some people dodge the crap, but others just stomp through it and get their own shoes dirty.

Speaker1: The inside's got fleece too. The hat's the only flaw, though.
Speaker2: What's wrong with the hat?
Speaker1: Lmao, that's hilarious.
Speaker2: But you keep saying the hat's fine, lol.

Speaker1: That's why a 9th-grade civil servant is the way to go; way better than trying to get into a big company.
Speaker2: That's just nonsense; even if you get laid off after a decade at a big company, 9th grade pays way better in the long run.
Speaker1: Shut it, 9th grade is the best!
Speaker2: Back in the day, 9th grade was legit—wife supporting you, solid pension. But now? Good luck getting married, pensions getting slashed, and "god-level" public servants? Please.

Speaker1: I realized none of my old coworkers want me to succeed after leaving and starting my own business.
Speaker2: Of course. If you do well after leaving, the ones who stayed will feel like losers.
Speaker1: They gotta feel superior by seeing me struggle just to buy me a meal.
Speaker2: No one's gonna want you to do well except for family. Everyone else will just be jealous.
Speaker1: I’m gonna succeed no matter what, just to avoid that crap. Gonna make them all bow down in front of me.

Speaker1: Sounds like a crappy phone or computer, huh?
Speaker2: Guess you’ve got a crap brain if you love crap so much.
Speaker1: It's only hard for idiots; it's easy for me.
Speaker2: Where's the crappy phone, computer, and internet that lags even on maps these days?

Speaker1: What kinda nonsense are you talking about?
Speaker2: So they experimented on identical twins, huh? How far you gonna run from that? lol
Speaker1: People like you, who think everything's true just because there's research, can keep living in that delusion forever.
Speaker2: Then provide more reliable info or explain it logically, or something.

Speaker1: Should've really nailed it back then. What a waste.
Speaker2: For real, that would've felt so good; I really couldn't stand it.
Speaker1: Sucks to be him, mooching off all the seniors and messing with the juniors, then ends up in jail lol.
Speaker2: No one can deny it was a hundred percent wrong not to have hit him then.

Speaker1: I think I can’t make it to work today, my stomach just started hurting. Sorry!
Speaker2: Again? You bailed last week too and made things a pain, what's up with that?
Speaker1: What am I supposed to do if I'm sick? I just have a weak stomach.
Speaker2: If you're that weak, you shouldn't be working. Can't just mess up other people's workplaces like that.
Speaker1: That's kinda harsh, even if you're the boss.
Speaker2: No need to work for a boss like that. From tomorrow, just stay home and take care of yourself.

Speaker1: Back in the day, the Halka at Pagoda was five bucks an hour, and I really used to love that.
Speaker2: I miss the good old days~

Speaker1: After the exam, a ton of posts about sex work pop up in the communities.
Speaker2: You think they're selling themselves to get into college?
Speaker1: Once a towel's a rag, it's done for.
Speaker2: Even if you wash a rag, it's still a rag; they should teach that in school.

Speaker1: Why's it so funny that the influencer's only doing rain stuff? Lmao, cracks me up every time.
Speaker2: I was kinda annoyed at first, but now I’m just enjoying it like watching monkeys at the zoo, haha.
Speaker1: I feel like they’ll die young if they keep gaining like that... I’m kinda worried, so I’d lose some weight.
Speaker2: I saw one that died in their 30s; if you gain weight, your blood vessels get blocked and you’re done for.

Speaker1: They're saying the drop in youth crime in the U.S. since then is because of the generation born after abortion was legalized.
Speaker2: So you're saying parents who didn't abort and raised their kids are idiots, huh? lol
Speaker1: This country was all about female abortions 20-30 years ago, but the antisocial behavior of those girls just got worse. Seems like a whip is the answer for beasts, lol.
Speaker2: Back in the day, the 82-born Kim Ji-youngs who faced female fetus abortion definitely couldn’t act like today’s girls.

Speaker1: Guess there are always warning signs before a big event. They covered it up and now dozens are dead.
Speaker2: Seriously, what the hell?
Speaker1: They were going off about how we don't need the law, huh? lol
Speaker2: They're out here saying it's a tough country for businesses even with people dying like this.

Speaker1: They’re all eager to snatch up new hires, huh?
Speaker2: Guys are tough on guys, and girls are tough on girls too.
Speaker1: But seriously, none of those turf-war idiots are worth a damn.
Speaker2: It's just how those idiots communicate.

Speaker1: They say if we live to our life expectancy, 3 out of 10 people will get cancer.
Speaker2: Isn't that more like a cruel hope than a life expectancy?
Speaker1: What’s the point of a 100-year life when 80% of seniors in Korea are living in poverty?
Speaker2: I think we should introduce euthanasia here too. Live as long as you want, then go when you’re ready.
Speaker1: I think living longer with poor quality isn't worth it.

Speaker1: But if they can't even do delivery, how are they gonna make a living? Getting a regular job's even tougher.
Speaker2: Isn't that obvious??? How do you know what they'll do when the door's open?
Speaker1: Seriously, with all the crime out there, singling out just one type like sexual offenses makes no sense.
Speaker2: One criminal got caught, lol. If you’re mad, don’t commit sexual crimes.

Speaker1: Seems like senior zones are the way to go these days.
Speaker2: You don't know about the senior coffee shop incident?
Speaker1: At least those guys still place an order, though.
Speaker2: Forcing them to drink when they're already full from coffee? That's just asking for trouble.
Speaker1: Yeah, those moms bring 4 girls and order just one serving of tteokbokki, smh.
Speaker2: Old folks are just sitting there like, "Aren't you taking orders?" acting all entitled.

Speaker1: The subway in Seoul's rich and poor neighborhoods is a huge difference, haha.
Speaker2: Where in Seoul are you talking about? Have you even used the subway there?
Speaker1: The difference from the escalator to the subway restrooms is huge haha.
Speaker2: Like, how messed up do you have to be to think like that?

Speaker1: I rushed my mom to the ER after she suddenly collapsed. Please pray for her, everyone.
Speaker2: Is there even time to post on social media in a situation like that? I don’t get it.
Speaker1: Just needed someone to pray. It's just a waiting game at the hospital.
Speaker2: How about putting the phone down and praying for yourself in the meantime?
Speaker1: You're the one being nosy. Stop stirring the pot and just move along.

Speaker1: Aren't kid cafes just asking for that kind of stuff with a kids' zone?
Speaker1: Sounds like they’re saying they wish they wouldn’t take kids in 'cause they’re a pain.
Speaker2: Just live your life without complaining, 'cause it's all your fault anyway.
Speaker1: How about you spend that time complaining about your own life instead of venting for some random person you don’t even know?

Speaker1: They should be fired and punished, not just have their resignation accepted!
Speaker2: Lmao, they shouldn't even process the resignation? That’s a broke move for 250,000 won.
Speaker1: Gotta fire them and take away their pension for trying to game the system like that.
Speaker2: Gotta get that pension even if you go to jail, lol.

Speaker1: Those 2030 Hanam guys are dragging their lives into hard mode, just accept it, it’s game over.
Speaker2: Honestly, it’s kinda annoying to pin the issues of all 2030 guys on just a handful of YouTube addicts or cult followers.
Speaker1: When it comes to this, it’s a universal problem, huh? One girl messes up and suddenly it’s all girls’ fault, what a joke lol.
Speaker2: You gotta wonder how bad things must be for those young guys.

Speaker1: No way I'm renting to anyone in their 20s... They trash the place and stick whatever they want on the walls... Families with kids are out too.
Speaker2: Renting out some cheap one-room in the sticks, huh? lol
Speaker1: It's in the countryside, but it's an apartment. Not touching anything that won't sell... Just ignore it and move on.
Speaker2: You didn't take out a loan to buy it, did you?

Speaker1: Those kids claiming they can function on less sleep are just fakes.
Speaker2: If you don’t sleep, you get all foggy, cranky, depressed, tired, and it leads to dementia, for real.
Speaker1: The only time that "sleep less to succeed" line works is in school; you gotta sleep during your growth years to keep your brain in good shape later.
Speaker2: Of course, even if you tell them, parents will be blinded by greed and say don’t sleep.

Speaker1: Being overly self-conscious after thirty is just plain ugly.
Speaker2: Haha, for real, being self-aware like that is a blessing.
Speaker1: Once you hit your 30s, if you’re not open-minded, it’s pretty much game over.
Speaker2: Gotta keep your head in the game; looking foolish can happen in a flash.
Speaker1: Gotta be careful before that combo of experience, stubbornness, and old-man vibes turns us into a total mess.

Speaker1: Hope the new hire's sharp.
Speaker2: Don’t expect much from the MZ crowd these days; if they can just understand what you’re saying, that’s a win.
Speaker1: Sounds about right, that one in the other team can't even answer calls. Guess mom did everything for them? lol
Speaker2: At least it’s a win if Mom doesn’t have to call in saying the kid overslept.

Speaker1: I really hope I hit the lottery. I can't stand myself not working, but I bet my boss hates seeing me too.
Speaker2: Everyone needs an adjustment period. You're just too anxious and always on edge.
Speaker1: The only way for me to chill and live easy is the lottery.
Speaker2: No wonder you can’t get anything done with that mindset.

Speaker1: This actor's so cute, right? They just seem to have that childlike spirit, like their whole vibe is adorable.
Speaker2: Childlike? Lmao, sounds more like acting immature.
Speaker1: Nah, it’s a show. Gotta do this kinda stuff to keep up the image.
Speaker2: Yikes, if it were me, I’d rather do manual labor than pull that kind of stunt at over 30. What a mess.

Speaker1: If they're gonna do that, why even let us leave reviews?
Speaker2: They just want you to write good reviews that help their business.
Speaker1: I tried dipping it in soy sauce and mustard, but it still smelled bad, so I couldn't eat it. What's wrong with leaving a review for other customers to know?

Speaker1: I’ve been recording at the convenience store lately 'cause of all the difficult customers.
Speaker2: Isn't it illegal to record without consent?
Speaker1: They say it's cool as long as my voice is in it. So many people totally disrespect me just 'cause I'm a cashier, it's driving me crazy.
Speaker2: For sure, you’ll deal with less unfair stuff.
Speaker1: Used it a few times. The manager just sides with the customers without knowing anything.
Speaker2: The world’s big, and there are plenty of idiots.

Speaker1: Why do you say "thank you" every time the waiter brings the food?
Speaker2: I'm just thanking them for the service.
Speaker1: Why say thanks when I’m paying for it? Just seems kinda lame.
Speaker2: You’re not wrong, but it’s all good vibes. Plus, it’s just a habit now.
Speaker1: Honestly, I'd rather have a robot bring it. No need to see any unfamiliar faces.

Speaker1: Who won the Nobel Prize in Literature this year again?
Speaker2: Don’t say “our women,” that writer won, not our women.
Speaker1: The reason Han men are obsessed with those Japanese girls is 'cause they're a culture optimized for looks over everything else, with nothing in their heads.
Speaker2: Anyway, with that smile and natural looks, Korean girls would totally slay even K-pop idols, but working out seems like a waste.

Speaker1: Those pros who manage their careers and cash in on severance are the first to bounce. They're living the dream.
Speaker2: Where are semiconductor engineers even gonna go?
Speaker1: Even if semiconductor engineers get laid off, they know their stuff in electrical work, so getting a certification and doing contract work is still a better life than yours.
Speaker2: Yikes, engineers don’t have many options, you know? These irreplaceable pros are acting like they’re not replaceable at all.

Speaker1: He's from South America.
Speaker2: Yeah, totally has that South American vibe.
Speaker1: It's impressive to say that to a guy who's a total mess.
Speaker2: Nah, I’d be throwing up just looking at that face.

Speaker1: Haha, did you see the pic I sent? He said I should go on a blind date.
Speaker2: Whoa, I’m seriously shocked. You probably dressed up for it, but your toes are probably prettier than that person's face lol.
Speaker1: Even family can't be trusted lol. If he makes good money, I might let it slide if he's a chaebol heir.
Speaker2: Lmao, whatever, money talks, right?

Speaker1: I can’t believe people are walking around in their college hoodies in the neighborhood, it’s so cringy.
